cs.t: I’ve had to repair my Miele dishwasher several times. (Faulty heater relay, common problem with the model.) also coincidentally the spring in the door broke yesterday. Otherwise it does clean the dishes very well and it’s quiet and attractive looking. I bought it because they have a good rep. But I’ve owned this dishwasher for 15 years and it’s still going. My Fisher and Paykel fridge I’ve had for 20+ years and it’s never needed any maintenance whatsoever. To me that’s pretty amazing.
cs.th: What do wealthy people buy, that ordinary people know nothing about? (2015)
